name: Lama Atallah
title: Corporate trainer and executive communication coach
profile: Lama is a corporate trainer and ICF certified coach with more than 15 years' experience supporting senior professionals across government, education and industry. She teaches strategic communication at Abu Dhabi University and has delivered executive training for UAE ministries, authorities and national companies including ADNOC, DEWA, Mubadala and Dubai Police. She holds a master's degree in communication from the University of Ottawa and trains in English and Arabic.
